title: Protocol v1: the body of POST /v1/import
description: The envelope of envelope.json, with items limited to the two types the import endpoint takes: ai.usage and deploy. Any other type is refused by the server as type_not_allowed (per item, the request stays 202). Items may be up to 400 days old instead of 7, which a schema cannot express (see common.json#/$defs/timestamp). Only secret (sk_) keys may call the endpoint.
